Fine-resolution BTC (365 windows), Alpha Vantage context, derivatives, options and news are being resolved in parallel. loss_calibration_sweeps.interpretation: A magnitude-aware loss shows a WEAK, UNSTABLE edge: TGT-D_quantile: WF median 0.69109 vs base 0.69315, 3/5 folds beat baseline. The WF median passes the threshold but folds disagree (not >=80% consistent) and AUCs are ~0.5, so there is no reliable ranking for calibration to rescue. Consistent with the prescribed global wording (weak/unstable). NOT qualified; carry as a candidate into the full battery + sealed TEST_V2 — do not adopt.

test_v2_power_analysis.interpretation: sigma≈0.07423. At N=672 the test resolves only an edge of ~0.00802 nats at 80% power; detecting the pre-registered delta*=0.01 needs N≈433. Pre-registered target set to 672 (672 is sufficient). Edges below the resolvable MDE are TEST-POWER-LIMITED, not disprovable by V2 — a distinct, honest limit from information-limited.

COARSE_2H_CORE.def: P1.1 frozen >=2h (8 marks strictly before T0)

coarse_reconciliation: Definition gap (documented, not a bug): P1.1 requires 8 marks STRICTLY BEFORE T0 (t0-15m..t0-120m); the factory chain also counts the boundary mark ending exactly AT T0 (immediate predecessor, proven available <=T0) and needs 9 contiguous marks. At the edges of contiguous runs the two rules admit slightly different windows -> the 11-window gap.
